title: Spa Chemistry Test Status Mix
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:chemistry
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(test_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the spa chemistry test feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `test_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the overall mood of your spa chemistry test feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
